codeReview.summary: The commit integrates resolved-contract prompt stack composition and delegation role metadata, emits decision-ledger records for delegation events, adds deep-link handling for runs/sessions hash params, and adds backend/e2e integration coverage aligned with the cross-area requirements. I found one non-blocking UX issue in sessions deep-link behavior when using the new path-form route.

issues.description: When opened via the new `/sessions/:sessionId` route, `deepLinkedSessionID` always prioritizes the path param, while `openSession` only updates `?session=`. This can keep forcing the original path session and prevents switching to another session from the table until the URL path changes.
